answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation with slashing: every agent locks a deposit before entering the task market, and peers attest to its completed work. Misbehavior burns the deposit. A sybil attacker spawning a thousand sockpuppets must post a thousand deposits, turning the attack into a deep canyon of cost no botnet will cross. Meanwhile an honest agent composes a single sonnet of verified history it can replay in any market, while the sybil farm has no roots — unlike an orchard grown from one seed, each fake identity must pay the full price again.
